senses.gloss:
व्रज्या vraj-yā, f. gait;
 division, groups, class.

व्रणय vraṇa-ya, den. P. wound: pp. ita, 🞄wounded;
 ulcerated: -hṛdaya, a. heart-stricken.

व्रणिन् vraṇ-in, a. wounded;
 covered with 🞄sores.
व्रतति vratáti (sts. ī), f. creeper.
व्रद् VRAD, व्रन्द VRAND, Ā. vradate, 🞄become soft, give way (RV.¹).
व्रन्दिन् vrand-ín, a. growing slack (RV.²).
व्रा vrā́, f. host, troop (RV.).
व्राध् VRĀDH, only vrādhanta and pr. 🞄pt. vrā́dhat, wax mightily: pr. pt. 🞄mighty (RV.).
